slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Chad appears only in the annex's score bands from the October 2016 self-reported monitoring round: digitisation of the civil registration system under 35% (the lowest band, with 20 other countries), infrastructure and resources 35-49%, overall system 35-49%. The composite band does not say which answer Chad gave on electronic capture at local offices, so no aspect value can be taken; no system is named.
